_comment: The heartbeat wire contract between the seat and ss-console (ss#2287).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. On 2026-08-11 the #2280 audit found that the seat had
been emitting webhook_surface_ok + webhook_surface on EVERY heartbeat since
ss#2222 and ss-console had no column, no parser and no alert for either. The
whole warn tier was written to the wire and dropped at ingest, silently, for
as long as it had existed. Nothing could have caught it: the two halves live
in different repos and no test asserted they agree.
WHAT IT IS. Every field the PINNED overlay's shared/heartbeat.py build_payload
can put on the wire, paired with the fleet_status column ss-console stores it
in and a sample value. tests/heartbeat-field-parity.test.ts posts each sample
at the real ingest handler and fails if the column stays NULL -- so a field
listed here without a reader is a failing test, not a silent drop.
overlay_ref is the OVERLAY_REF this list was read against, and it must equal
ARG OVERLAY_REF in operator/templates/Dockerfile. That pin is the only way a
new overlay field reaches a seat, so bumping it fails this gate until someone
re-reads build_payload at the new ref and re-stamps this file. Read the
limits of that in the test's header before trusting it further than it goes.

fields._comment: Emitted by overlay origin/main but not by the pinned ref. The console reading AHEAD of the pin is harmless; reading BEHIND it is the ss#2287 defect, which is the only direction the local cross-check enforces.
fields.name: cron_containment
